turns.text: They say, "The holy water's watered down
turns.zh: 他们说，圣水已经掺了水

turns.text: And this town's lost its faith
turns.zh: 这座小镇也失去了信仰

turns.text: Our colors will fade eventually"
turns.zh: 我们的色彩终将褪去

turns.text: So, if our time is runnin' out
turns.zh: 所以，如果我们的时间快用完了

turns.text: Day after day
turns.zh: 日复一日

turns.text: We'll make the mundane our masterpiece
turns.zh: 我们要把平淡生活变成杰作

turns.text: Oh, my, my
turns.zh: 哦，天哪

turns.text: Oh, my, my love
turns.zh: 哦，我的爱

turns.text: I take one look at you
turns.zh: 我只要看你一眼

turns.text: You're takin' me out of the ordinary
turns.zh: 你就把我带出了平凡

turns.text: I want you layin' me down 'til we're dead and buried
turns.zh: 我要你把我放倒，直到我们死去入土

turns.text: On the edge of your knife, stayin' drunk on your vine
turns.zh: 在你刀刃的边缘，沉醉在你的藤蔓上

turns.text: The angels up in the clouds are jealous knowin' we found
turns.zh: 云端的众天使都嫉妒，知道我们找到了

turns.text: Somethin' so out of the ordinary
turns.zh: 如此超凡脱俗的东西

turns.text: You got me kissin' thе ground of your sanctuary
turns.zh: 你让我亲吻你圣地的地面

turns.text: Shatter me with your touch, oh, Lord, return mе to dust
turns.zh: 用你的触碰粉碎我，哦，主啊，让我归于尘土

turns.text: The angels up in the clouds are jealous knowin' we found
turns.zh: 云端的众天使都嫉妒，知道我们找到了

turns.text: Hopeless hallelujah
turns.zh: 绝望的哈利路亚

turns.text: On this side of Heaven's gate
turns.zh: 在天堂之门的这一边

turns.text: Oh, my life, how do ya
turns.zh: 哦，我的生命，你怎么

turns.text: Breathe and take my breath away?
turns.zh: 呼吸着，却带走了我的呼吸？

turns.text: At your altar, I will pray
turns.zh: 在你的祭坛前，我会祈祷

turns.text: You're the sculptor, I'm the clay
turns.zh: 你是雕塑家，我是黏土
